local_visual_review_notes: Actually viewed attempt 000006 front and rear RTX images: one red/black barred prison leaf sits within the full separate frame, with both levers, upper bars and lower hatch visible. The open display duplicate is absent as intended; textures and handedness remain coherent.
local_mechanical_review_notes: The closed-unlatched source tongue 10 retains its visual but no collision. Leaf 14, frame 19, both handles, edge plates and hinge barrels retain collision. Reviewed 2% uniform fitting and frame partitions resolve closed source/collider contacts. Static and one isolated RTX 4090 run pass at the prepared geometry limit of 23.1 degrees; the low limit is explicit and no 45-degree robot criterion was applied.
